name: Masumi Chris
source:
The primary protagonist. He passed the examination as a supplementary student. He's just grateful to be given a chance to go to an elite school. Fell in love with Alice the first day of school and is so excited to be her partner he's even willing to put up with her mean hidden personality.

He's so effeminate it's a shock to everyone that he has a huge penis, the largest of anyone in his class.
